description: the INIS Geoportal of Romania is an open data portal listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ANCPI. Geo Data Portal Romania. Coverage: Romania. The European data portal lists 240 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 20 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 16 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.

discovery_routes.query: multilingual title search through the European data portal search API
